name: yzmir-counterfactual-statistics
description: Statistical methodology for counterfactual and paired-branch ML experiments - paired comparisons against a no-op anchor, clustered statistical units (the trajectory, not the branch), grouped splits and the leakage taxonomy, best-of-K selection-bias correction, abstention calibration, pre-registration, and quality-cost-stability frontier reporting. Router + 13 reference sheets, 3 commands, 2 SME agents.
